name: Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules on assayathon_demo
rationale: Objective is simplest_to_make. Cell preparation (steps 1-6, 8, 9), cold gelation, split, index PCR, shell digestion and bead clean-up stay at the bench, where the lab has the incubator, centrifuge, cold plate, thermocycler and pipette. Three chips remain. (1) Oil-phase encapsulation, kept apart from everything else. (2) Emulsion breaking, photocuring on the led_405nm, washes and aggregate filtering. (3) Lysis, washes and RT in a trap. Index PCR (up to 95 C) is above the 50 C limit of the resin, so split and PCR move off chip to the thermocycler. Shell digestion (step 22) also goes off chip, because the trap would need retention finer than the process allows. The traps now use pillar retention at 60 um, the smallest gap the process makes. This is below the roughly 70 um capsule size, but it is not the half-size rule. The 200 um minimum nozzle makes droplets larger than 70 um, so 60 um pillars still hold them. The cell filter (step 7) needs about 30 um, below the 60 um process minimum, so it is listed as missing.

chips.name: Encapsulation chip
chips.purpose: Cells in core solution are pinched into shell-polymer droplets by fluorinated oil at a flow-focusing junction.
chips.why_separate: First chip: the pump-driven cell stream starts the flow. Oil must not reach any other chip, and the gelation that follows is off chip.

modules.does: The cell/core stream arrives on the main line (centre). The shell_polymer and fluorinated_oil lines pinch it into droplets. The nozzle is the smallest the part allows (200 um), so droplets will be larger than the 70 um target.

chips.name: Emulsion break, curing, wash and capsule filter chip
chips.purpose: Breaks the emulsion, photocures the shells, washes the capsules and removes aggregates.
chips.why_separate: Oil has to be removed before the capsules move on. This chip needs the 405 nm light, and the droplets arrive after the off-chip cold gelation.

modules.does: Pillars 60 um apart (the process minimum) hold the capsules. Emulsion-breaking agent (own line) flushes the oil out, then photoinitiator is flushed in and cured under 405 nm. The same water-based reagent_line carries photoinitiator and then wash buffer, with the syringe swapped between steps.
Pillar filter with 100 um gaps removes capsule aggregates as the capsules flow on.

chips.name: Lysis, wash and reverse transcription chip
chips.purpose: Lyses the cells, washes, and runs reverse transcription inside the capsules held in one trap.
chips.why_separate: New protocol section (Methods 2.3) with warm enzymatic steps, kept clear of the light-curing chip.

modules.does: Pillars 60 um apart hold the capsules while lysis buffer, wash buffer, RT mix and wash buffer are flushed through in turn. They share one water-based reagent_line, with the syringe swapped between steps. The chip sits on a heater for the incubations.

off_chip.why: Culture, rinse and enzyme detachment of adherent cells in a vessel, done off chip.
Quench, centrifuge and wash are done at the bench with the centrifuge.
Counting and viability check are done at the bench.
Resuspending in core solution is a pipette step before loading the syringe for chip 1.
The emulsion is gelled on the cold plate off chip. A 30 min delay line would not fit a 30 x 20 mm chip.
Index PCR reaches 95 C, above the 50 C limit of the printed resin. The capsules are split into four portions by pipette and cycled in the thermocycler, each with its own index primer mix.
Shell digestion would need a trap with retention finer than the process allows. It is done at the bench by pipette.
Bead binding, ethanol washes and elution are done as a bench kit. The lab has no magnet.
Library concentration and fragment size are measured on bench instruments.

missing_parts.need: pillar filter with about 30 um gap (0.75 x the encapsulation nozzle) for cells upstream of the junction
missing_parts.why: A 30 um gap is below the smallest gap the process makes (60 um).
missing_parts.workaround: Strain the cells off chip with a 30-40 um cell strainer before loading chip 1.
